The live source projection was independently checked against PHP-owned tables: 4 active e-invoice rows and 0 active purchase rows were present in the throwaway database, so the rendered pack correctly remained sample-labelled and populated source-document drill-down rows were not claimed. External-reporting fetch/import/intake remains read-only on ASP.NET; dry-run returned zero writes, confirmed generation was refused, invalid action was refused, and unauthenticated access was denied. No live tenant or production data was touched.

Throwaway MariaDB rehearsal used uniquely tagged DEVIN-B7 rows only. Cash-account dry-run returned zero writes, empty-name dry-run and confirmed requests were denied, and confirmed creation persisted a tagged cash account with AED currency, opening balance, active status, notes, and authenticated admin ownership; direct SQL corroborated the row, the PHP-owned audit log recorded admin_id=1/action=cash_account_create/entity_type=account with the tagged name and account type, and cleanup returned the tagged count to zero. An authenticated payment-batch dry-run returned zero writes, invalid batch type was refused, and confirmed local batch creation persisted PAY-1 with account, amount, line count, status, execution date, notes, and authenticated admin ownership; the list/open projection read the row back. A tagged cash entry and bank statement line were then matched through the authenticated bank-reconciliation endpoint: dry-run returned zero writes, invalid line/entry IDs returned HTTP 400 with zero writes, confirmed matching updated matched_entry_id and reconciled, direct SQL corroborated the values, the PHP-owned audit log recorded bank_reconcile/cash_entry/admin_id, and the summary/line projection returned matched counts and source metadata. The bank_import contract was audited against PHP: ASP.NET now parses the PHP date/description/reference/amount CSV shape and writes PHP-owned epc_erp_bank_statement_lines only when confirmWrites is supplied; account validation and dry-run zero-write blocking were verified, while authenticated confirmed persistence and SQL cleanup remain unverified because the local tenant-registry/login fixture is unavailable. Collections case save, promise-to-pay transition, activity logging, dunning validation/dry-run, confirmed dunning notices, direct SQL readback, credit-hold place/release with PHP credit-profile preservation, invalid hold denial, and cleanup also passed. The collections page rendered its workspace shell, but populated browser row readback remains unverified. All previously tagged rows were deleted and verified at zero. Payment-batch line/processing, bank-import confirmed readback, isolation, recovery, UAT, and production gates remain unverified; no live tenant or production data was touched.

The PHP withholding schema and lifecycle contract were audited from content/shop/finance/epc_erp_withholding.php: epc_wht_code and epc_wht_txn remain PHP-owned, record writes validate an existing code and positive base amount, calculate rate-based withholding with PHP half-up rounding, and start transactions in accrued status. ASP.NET native form aliases, dry-run zero-write blocking, invalid-code/amount denials, and the calculation parity cases are covered by ErpWhtRecordPhpParityTests; no table creation or live-tenant migration is introduced. The tax toolkit fixture mirrors PHP epc_tax_toolkit_world_meta_for_country and epc_tax_toolkit_world_cit_for_country for AE, SA, IN, DE, and AU, including kit code, VAT/GST rate, registration label, currency, corporate-tax rates, and the UAE threshold; unknown countries retain PHP's manual corporate-tax fallback. The country-obligation fixture mirrors PHP epc_bos_compliance_seed_obligations for common e-invoicing/payroll obligations, AE FTA/ESR obligations, SA ZATCA obligations, and the generic tax-authority fallback; industry-specific AML/DNFBP obligations remain separate and unverified. The tax calculator contract resolves the tenant profile from PHP-owned epc_tax_toolkit_tenant_profile and epc_tax_toolkits rather than a user-selected country. The e-invoice country fixture matches the PHP epc_einv_country_profile map for AE, SA, IN, GB, DE, FR, IT, and AU, uses GENERIC/TAX for unknown countries, and proves that a preview country cannot override the registered tenant country. E-invoice credit-note dry-run validation remains write-blocked and refuses missing source documents; manual submission requires a validated document and configured ASP before queueing PHP-compatible event rows. Existing PHP/ASP.NET dual samples corroborate the action envelope but are not persistence acceptance. A throwaway local database is reachable, but the PHP withholding/e-invoice/toolkit/compliance tables are not provisioned there and authenticated tenant-registry login is not available in this tranche, so confirmed persistence, SQL/audit readback, ASP sandbox roundtrip, certificate/settlement lifecycle, browser parity, isolation, recovery, UAT, and production acceptance remain unverified. No live tenant or production data was touched.

Voucher sale/return, repair transfer/receive/delivery, true browser interaction, second-database isolation, recovery, UAT, and production gates remain open; PHP remains authoritative and live tenants remain untouched.
